project: SIH 2026 Landslide Early Warning & Risk Monitoring (Meghalaya)
section: Section 31: Model B Decision, Robustness & Error Analysis
scientific_decision_rationale: Defensible dynamic meteorological trigger signal driven by short-term precipitation (ARI-3 and Event-Day P0).
Retrospective Holdout ROC-AUC of 0.7653 and PR-AUC of 0.6631 on unseen East Khasi / Shillong terrain (Block 3).
Reliable detection of severe convective storms with 66.7% recall and 77.0% specificity at T = 0.20.
Observed spatial degradation from Jaintia Validation (ROC 0.8447 -> 0.7653) is consistent with steep orographic domain shifts.
model_a_plus_model_b_coupling_verdict: AUTHORIZED FOR CONTROLLED PHASE 4 INTEGRATION EXPERIMENT
coupling_conditions: Model A (Static Susceptibility) and Model B (Dynamic Trigger) must be evaluated as a coupled 2D Risk Matrix.
Dynamic Model B alone should not be deployed as an unconditioned standalone trigger.
Integration must maintain strict spatial isolation across test blocks.
